name: Swiss International Style
summary: Asymmetric layouts on a mathematical grid, one neo-grotesque sans serif, flush-left text and objective photography. It came out of Zurich and Basel in the 1950s and became the default language of corporate modernism.

philosophy.core_thesis: Design is a neutral carrier of information, and a mathematical grid makes that neutrality visible.
design_principles: Build every layout on a modular grid of 6 or 12 columns and align every element to a column edge and a baseline.
Use one sans-serif family for the whole piece, and make hierarchy with size and weight only.
Set all text flush left with a ragged right edge.
Compose asymmetrically: put the main mass off centre and balance it with empty space.
Use at most one accent colour in addition to black and white, and use it on less than 10% of the surface.
Jump between type sizes by a ratio of 1.5 or more, so that each level reads as a different level.
Prefer photography and plain diagrams to illustration, and crop photographs to grid modules.
anti_patterns: Centred body text or centred multi-line headlines
Drop shadows, gradients, glows or any simulated depth
Rounded corners on containers, images or buttons
A second typeface, script fonts or decorative display fonts
Decorative illustration, ornaments, emoji or stock icons used as filler
Elements placed by eye that do not sit on a grid line
Justified text with uneven word spacing

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column modular grid with 24px gutters and an 8px baseline; every block spans whole columns and every text line sits on the baseline.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 40–60% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24, 48, 96, 144px and nothing in between.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left, ragged right; shared left edges across sections; nothing is centred and nothing floats outside a column.
layout.container_geometry: Sharp rectangles with a 0px radius; sections are divided by 1px or 2px rules and by space, not by boxes or cards.

font_pairings.note: The closest open-source match to Helvetica at display and text sizes.
A little more character; nearer to Akzidenz-Grotesk.
A single-family setting, which is the orthodox choice.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.02em to -0.04em; body stays at 0; small upper-case labels take +0.06em.
typography.leading: Display 1.0 to 1.1; body 1.4 to 1.5; all line-heights are multiples of the 8px baseline.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights only: regular (400) and bold (700).
Use three or four sizes with large jumps, for example 14, 21, 48 and 96px.
Set headlines in sentence case or all lower case, and never in title case.
Put small labels and numerals in the margin column to index the content.

color.palette_structure: Black, white and one saturated primary; the accent covers less than 10% of the surface, or one full-bleed field.
color.contrast_rules: Body text holds at least 7:1 against its background; the accent carries large type or solid fields, never long text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, opaque, uncoated fields of solid colour; no texture, no gradient, no transparency.
color.light_and_shadow: None. There is no light source; depth comes only from scale, overlap and empty space.

materiality.surface_simulation: None; the surface is ink on paper and does not imitate any other material.
materiality.border_rules: Solid ink rules of 1px or 2px, used as dividers above sections; containers have no outline on all four sides.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; box-shadow and backdrop-filter stay at none on every element.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Geometric pictograms with a uniform 2px stroke or solid fill, square terminals and no perspective; use few of them.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Objective black-and-white photography or plain diagrams, cropped hard to grid modules; no decorative illustration.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: short functional moves along grid axes with no bounce, no overshoot and no parallax.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover inverts ink and paper or adds a 2px underline; active state shows the accent colour; nothing scales, lifts or glows.

emotion.target_response: Trust through order: the viewer feels that the information is objective, complete and easy to check.

avoid_when: The brand must feel playful, warm or handmade.
The audience is children or the product is a game.
The content has little text and relies on rich imagery of products with lifestyle context.

modifiers.how: Add a 4px radius and a second muted hue; keep the grid, the single typeface and the flush-left text.
Change the accent to an earth tone and let one illustration with organic shapes into the layout; keep the grid.
Raise the rules to 3px, add a hard offset shadow and a second loud accent; keep the 0px radius and the grid.
Close the open sections into cells with a 1px border; keep the type scale and the monochrome palette.
